items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: Cad's lip was sore like that.

ctx.x: don't have to bear a horn on it. Just enough to hold it against. That's right. That's right. Do you play with your lips wet or dry? No. Dry. Dry. It be wet like that. And the other

thing I don't play from up here. Comes right up. Blow from down your stomach. Down my stomach. You see I don't, you see plenty of fellas when they play a horn their neck swell like that. But I don't do that. Play my horn like that. Play from right from up like that. See when you're walking, you're bringing pressure up to you all the time like that. It's coming up to you all the time. In case you fellas blowin, all this button out all the neck. You know those like. Louis Armstrong does. Yeah. Louis Armstrong and…
I think Pickett had the same trouble. Pickett had the same trouble too. That's right. Yeah.
